profile.summary:
I've spent the last few years on website accessibility and compliance. I still get to work on that, but I also work in client onboarding, content management, and other services in support of website and web app products. This includes processing leads and analytics data, provisioning email and phone number services, automating hosting, API reliability and automated quality control on product implementations.

I have additional skills in cloud computing, especially deployments using containers. This means I am comfortable configuring CI pipelines, container builds using Docker Compose, planning groups of services using Helm, and Kubernetes.

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description: If the feature isn't "agent-something," then it's probably sitting in the backlog. Develop projects in TypeScript, Python, Ruby on Rails, and Go. A lot of workflow design with layered AIs, trying to decide if it's worth adopting a RAG or adapter or just wait a quarter for the agent harness to do it better without. The kinds of features we're implementing work best with just a sprinkle of AI rather than all AI. Predictability always trumps capability.
positions.insights: Skills: Process Improvement · Vue.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Node.js · Kubernetes · Nuxt.js · Vuex · PostgreSQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Release Management · Product Development

positions.title: Tooling Developer
positions.description:
I build tools for the Pro Services and Digital Strategy teams that automate tedious work, measure impact, and integrate front-end vendor software. 

I worked on a WCAG compliance scan and report system based on Deque's Axe-Core/Puppeteer implementation. The crawling component crawls all websites leaving implementation and returns a report for needed changes before the site goes live. We use the same tool to periodically scan existing websites and return a client-facing report that reflects changes the client has made to the site.

I also worked on a client onboarder that generates a custom onboarding experience based on the products purchased to reduce friction by asking for only required/relevant information.

positions.title: Platform Strategy Analyst
positions.description: Tasked with optimizing consumer-facing marketing product for SEO and CRO by implementing measurement and reporting.

positions.title: Client Experience Business Analyst
positions.description: Measurement, reporting and process improvement for the support teams at G5.

positions.title: Operations Support Analyst
positions.description: Manage the Quality Assurance Department for sites in the western United States. I directly supervise a team of analysts and coaches, but coordinate heavily with trainers, and a project manager. Developed training curricula, developed reporting and diagnostic materials, developed analysis tools using Excel, Access and custom web applications. Participate strongly in an industry certification process by contributing technical writing, leadership training and process implementation.

positions.title: Receiving Manager
positions.description: Created time management tools, and managed a small team of laborers. Interacted with shippers, and prioritized deployment of marketing materials, strict on sale products, and communicated with distribution on behalf of management.

positions.title: Photo Editor
positions.description: Worked in photoshop to push photo products to print. Developed new photo products and provided input into website development.

volunteerExperiences.role: Help local artists and musicians turn their passion into income by helping them with marketing.
volunteerExperiences.description: Kaycee was gracious to let me learn web development with her work. We used Indexibit originally, which is a portfolio CMS.
Volunteered to orient new computer users on using MS Office, especially Excel.

testScores.name: ACT
testScores.description: Was one point of being a state regents and having my school paid for. Alas, I didn't know I was that close at the time.
